scope: Dependency and license provenance needed to run the frozen target regression without importing or executing the full vLLM server.
newly_permitted_read_only_inputs: vLLM LICENSE file at the frozen baseline/fixed revisions
the exact vLLM dependency declaration for partial-json-parser, and only the lines required to identify its version constraint
the exact target source and regression-test paths already named in the parent protocol
prohibited: all other source, tests, PR discussion, task prompts, graders, or evaluator assets
any held-out task identity, source, test, grader, or outcome
network access during candidate or grader execution
execution_precondition: No candidate code or test has been executed. Before the first execution, bind exact source/test/runner/package/image hashes and all commands in a separate VARE execution addendum committed and pushed to this VARE branch.
stop_rule: If the relevant dependency cannot be pinned from frozen repository metadata and an immutable package artifact, stop without executing candidate code.
